photo.alt: View of Riga from St. Peter's Church

facts: Flat, sandy plain 1 to 10 m above sea level, at the mouth of the Daugava
worth_knowing: Founded in 1201 and a former Hanseatic League member. Its historical centre is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, noted for its Art Nouveau architecture.
